rootCause: The old page-level scale recognizer competed with the parent's drag until zoom exceeded 1x. Native ScrollDragActivity also suppresses child hit testing, preventing a late second pointer from reaching the child recognizer.
implementation: One outer viewport gesture owner; second pointer immediately claims the sequence
Proxy one-finger motion to native ScrollPosition drag and ballistic, not a competing parent recognizer
Hold pinch ownership until all pointers leave, even at minimum scale
Rebase at minimum scale to avoid an inward overshoot dead zone
Shared visible viewport for double-page and webtoon
